role_evidence.quote: [DRUG] RVP-001 (other names: Mn-PyC3A, mangaverate): MRI contrast agent

coder_notes: Imaging contrast-agent dose-finding trial across CNS lesions (tumours, MS); glioblastoma named in the inclusion criteria. No antitumour agent. The gadolinium-based comparator imaging is a screening procedure, not a registered intervention, so not listed. Three arms are dose cohorts, none a control.
